data.title: Coalition: UAV Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia toward Southern Region Intercepted, Destroyed
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that a UAV launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward the southern region was intercepted and destroyed.
    -- SPA
05:17 Local Time 02:17 GMT
0016
